rotate-first-page-pdf.title: Load PDF and Rotate First Page with PdfPageEditor
rotate-first-page-pdf.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF from a local file using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfPageEditor, optionally rotating the first page, and saving the edited document.

rotate-first-page-from-memory-stream.title: Rotate PDF Page from Memory Stream
rotate-first-page-from-memory-stream.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF from an in‑memory byte array into PdfPageEditor, rotating the first page, and saving the modified document back to a file without using the file system for the source PDF.

edit-pdf-page-zoom-save.title: Rotate First Page of PDF and Save with PdfPageEditor
edit-pdf-page-zoom-save.description: Demonstrates how to load a PDF, rotate the first page using PdfPageEditor, and save the edited document to a new file.

edit-pdf-in-memory-using-pdfpageeditor.title: Add Text Annotation and Save PDF to MemoryStream
edit-pdf-in-memory-using-pdfpageeditor.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF, adding a text annotation to the first page, and saving the modified document to a MemoryStream for further processing without disk I/O.

rotate-page-2-pdf-90-degrees.title: Rotate Second Page of PDF by 90 Degrees
rotate-page-2-pdf-90-degrees.description: Shows how to rotate page 2 of a PDF by 90° using the PdfPageEditor.PageRotations dictionary and save the modified document.

rotate-specific-pdf-pages.title: Rotate Specific PDF Pages by 180 Degrees
rotate-specific-pdf-pages.description: Demonstrates how to rotate selected pages (3, 5, and 7) of a PDF document by 180° using Aspose.Pdf and save the result.

rotate-specific-pdf-page.title: Rotate Page 4 by 180 Degrees Using PdfPageEditor
rotate-specific-pdf-page.description: Shows how to rotate the fourth page of a PDF document by 180° directly with Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfPageEditor.

retrieve-pdf-page-size.title: Retrieve Page 2 Size from PDF
retrieve-pdf-page-size.description: Demonstrates how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, access the second page, obtain its width and height, and log the dimensions.

retrieve-page-rotation.title: Get Page Rotation Angle Using PdfPageEditor
retrieve-page-rotation.description: Demonstrates how to bind a PDF file and retrieve the rotation angle of a specific page (page 4) using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfPageEditor.

resize-page-six-to-letter-size.title: Set Page Six to Letter Size in PDF
resize-page-six-to-letter-size.description: Shows how to load a PDF, verify that page 6 exists, and resize that page to Letter dimensions (8.5" x 11") using Aspose.Pdf.

set-page-zoom-to-150-percent.title: Set Zoom on Specific PDF Page
set-page-zoom-to-150-percent.description: Shows how to adjust the zoom level of page three in a PDF to 150 % using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfPageEditor.

zoom-even-pages-pdf.title: Scale Even-Numbered PDF Pages with 1.2 Zoom
zoom-even-pages-pdf.description: Shows how to apply a 1.2 (120%) zoom factor to all even‑numbered pages of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfPageEditor.

add-fade-transition-to-pdf-page.title: Apply Fade Transition to PDF Page
add-fade-transition-to-pdf-page.description: Shows how to set a fade transition and a two‑second duration for a specific page in a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfPageEditor.

apply-dissolve-transition-to-pdf-page.title: Apply Dissolve Transition to a PDF Page
apply-dissolve-transition-to-pdf-page.description: Demonstrates how to set a Dissolve page transition with a three‑second duration on page 5 of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.

set-display-duration-page-five.title: Set Display Duration for a PDF Page
set-display-duration-page-five.description: Shows how to configure the slide‑show display duration of page 5 in a PDF to five seconds using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfPageEditor.

align-page-two-left.title: Left‑justify Text on Second PDF Page
align-page-two-left.description: Demonstrates how to add a left‑aligned text fragment to the second page of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf's Alignment property and save the modified document.

align-page-three-vertically-top.title: Align Page 3 Content to Top Using PdfContentEditor
align-page-three-vertically-top.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF with PdfContentEditor, aligning the content of page 3 to the top using the Alignment enum, and saving the modified document (including a note about version requirements).

resize-pdf-pages-content-10-percent-marg.title: Resize PDF Page Contents with 10% Margin
resize-pdf-pages-content-10-percent-marg.description: Demonstrates how to apply a uniform 10 % margin to the contents of all pages in a PDF using Aspose.Pdf's ResizeContents method.

batch-rotate-first-page-pdfs.title: Rotate First Page of PDFs in a Folder
batch-rotate-first-page-pdfs.description: Demonstrates how to batch‑process PDF files in a directory, rotating the first page of each document by 90 degrees using Aspose.Pdf and saving the results to an output folder.

batch-convert-pdfs-to-a4.title: Batch Convert PDFs to A4 Page Size
batch-convert-pdfs-to-a4.description: Shows how to iterate over PDF files in a directory and resize each document to A4 dimensions using Aspose.Pdf's PdfPageEditor.

rotate-and-resize-pdf-page-to-letter.title: Rotate and Resize PDF Page to Letter
rotate-and-resize-pdf-page-to-letter.description: Shows how to rotate page 3 of a PDF by 90 degrees and change its dimensions to Letter size using Aspose.Pdf.

apply-zoom-to-non-consecutive-pdf-pages.title: Apply Zoom to Selected PDF Pages
apply-zoom-to-non-consecutive-pdf-pages.description: Shows how to specify non‑consecutive pages with the ProcessPages array and apply a common zoom factor using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfPageEditor.

set-page-transition-duration-for-selecte.title: Set Page Transition Duration for a Range of PDF Pages
set-page-transition-duration-for-selecte.description: Demonstrates how to select a range of pages using PdfPageEditor and apply a 1‑second fade transition to them.

rotate-pdf-pages-using-pdfpageeditor.title: Rotate PDF Pages with Validation
rotate-pdf-pages-using-pdfpageeditor.description: Demonstrates how to validate a rotation angle and apply it to all pages of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

handle-invalid-rotation-value.title: Validate and Apply PDF Page Rotation Safely
handle-invalid-rotation-value.description: Demonstrates how to validate a rotation angle before setting it on a PDF page using Aspose.Pdf, handling invalid values and preventing runtime errors.

create-contentsresizeparameters-with-uni.title: Create ContentsResizeParameters with Uniform Margins
create-contentsresizeparameters-with-uni.description: Demonstrates how to instantiate a ContentsResizeParameters object with absolute margins of five points on all sides, ready for use with PdfFileEditor to resize page contents.

apply-different-zoom-levels-to-pdf-pages.title: Apply Per-Page Zoom Levels to PDF Using PdfPageEditor
apply-different-zoom-levels-to-pdf-pages.description: Shows how to set a different zoom factor for each page of a PDF by iterating through pages with PdfPageEditor and saving the modified document.

apply-fade-transition-to-all-pdf-pages.title: Set Fade Transition for All PDF Pages
apply-fade-transition-to-all-pdf-pages.description: Demonstrates how to apply a Fade page transition to every page of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf's PdfPageEditor.

assign-page-transitions-by-content.title: Set Page Transitions Based on Content Type
assign-page-transitions-by-content.description: The example loads a PDF, detects whether each page contains only images, only text, or a mix, and applies a corresponding page transition (Fade, Split, or Blinds) using Aspose.Pdf's PdfPageEditor before saving the document.

set-page-display-duration-by-word-count.title: Set Per-Page Display Duration Based on Word Count
set-page-display-duration-by-word-count.description: Extracts text from each PDF page, counts the words, and assigns a display duration proportional to the word count using PdfPageEditor.

chain-page-rotation-size-zoom-modificati.title: Chain Page Rotation, Resize, and Zoom before Saving PDF
chain-page-rotation-size-zoom-modificati.description: Shows how to rotate pages, change their size, and apply a viewer zoom using Aspose.Pdf Document and PdfPageEditor, then save the modified PDF.

reset-page-rotation-to-zero.title: Reset Page Rotation in PDF
reset-page-rotation-to-zero.description: Shows how to reset the rotation of a specific PDF page (page 6) to 0 degrees using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfPageEditor.

revert-pdf-page-size-to-original.title: Revert PDF Page Size to Original Dimensions
revert-pdf-page-size-to-original.description: Loads a PDF, stores the original dimensions of a specific page, changes the page size, then restores the original size before saving the document.

audit-pdf-page-dimensions-rotation.title: Log PDF Page Dimensions and Rotation Before and After Editing
audit-pdf-page-dimensions-rotation.description: Demonstrates how to record each page's width, height, and rotation before and after adding a text stamp, writing the information to an audit log file.

apply-horizontal-alignment-to-pdf-pages.title: Apply Left Horizontal Alignment to All PDF Pages
apply-horizontal-alignment-to-pdf-pages.description: Shows how to left‑justify the content of every page in a PDF using Aspose.Pdf's PdfPageEditor and the HorizontalAlignment property.

apply-vertical-alignment-to-selected-pdf.title: Apply Vertical Alignment to Selected PDF Pages
apply-vertical-alignment-to-selected-pdf.description: Shows how to set the vertical alignment of specific pages in a PDF to top using Aspose.Pdf's PdfPageEditor.

set-boxout-transition-on-pdf-page.title: Apply BoxOut Transition to PDF Page
set-boxout-transition-on-pdf-page.description: Demonstrates how to use Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfPageEditor to set a BoxOut page transition with a three‑second duration on a specific PDF page.

set-cover-transition-on-pdf-page.title: Apply Cover Transition to PDF Page
set-cover-transition-on-pdf-page.description: Shows how to set a Cover page transition with a 1‑second duration on page 4 of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.

set-zoom-of-page-to-75-percent.title: Set Page Zoom to 75% Using PdfPageEditor
set-zoom-of-page-to-75-percent.description: Demonstrates how to set the initial view zoom of a specific PDF page (page 5) to 75% using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfPageEditor.

set-zoom-on-specific-pdf-page.title: Set Page Zoom to 200% Using PdfPageEditor
set-zoom-on-specific-pdf-page.description: Shows how to use Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfPageEditor to apply a 2.0 zoom (200% magnification) to a specific PDF page and save the modified document.

resize-pdf-page-contents-negative-margin.title: Shrink PDF Page Contents by 5% Using PdfPageEditor
resize-pdf-page-contents-negative-margin.description: Demonstrates how to uniformly scale down the contents of every page in a PDF by applying a 5 % negative margin using the PdfPageEditor.Zoom property.

add-20-percent-margins-to-pdf-pages.title: Add 20% Margin to PDF Pages
add-20-percent-margins-to-pdf-pages.description: Shows how to create uniform 20% whitespace margins around every page of a PDF by scaling the page content with PdfPageEditor.

convert-pdf-pages-to-landscape.title: Convert PDF Pages to Landscape Orientation
convert-pdf-pages-to-landscape.description: Shows how to change each page of a PDF from portrait to landscape by applying A4 landscape dimensions with Aspose.Pdf.

convert-portrait-to-landscape.title: Convert PDF Page from Portrait to Landscape
convert-portrait-to-landscape.description: Demonstrates how to change a PDF page's orientation from portrait to landscape by swapping its width and height, setting the landscape flag, optionally rotating the content, and saving the result.

rotate-pdf-page-180-preserve-transitions.title: Apply Transition and Rotate PDF Page by 180°
rotate-pdf-page-180-preserve-transitions.description: Shows how to set a page transition effect with PdfPageEditor and then rotate the same page 180 degrees using the Rotation property.

resize-and-rotate-pdf-page.title: Resize and Rotate PDF Page by 90 Degrees
resize-and-rotate-pdf-page.description: Shows how to read a PDF page's dimensions, enlarge the page canvas, and apply a 90° clockwise rotation using Aspose.Pdf.

incremental-update-pdf-text-annotation.title: Save PDF with Incremental Update Using Aspose.Pdf
incremental-update-pdf-text-annotation.description: Demonstrates copying a PDF, adding a text annotation, and saving the document with incremental update mode to preserve the original file structure.

edit-pdf-pages-save-new-file.title: Create PDF Backup and Add Text Stamp
edit-pdf-pages-save-new-file.description: Demonstrates how to copy a PDF for backup, load it with Aspose.Pdf, add a visible text stamp to the first page, and save the edited version as a new file.

set-page-display-duration-for-pdf-slides.title: Set Per-Page Display Duration for PDF Slideshow
set-page-display-duration-for-pdf-slides.description: Shows how to assign a custom display duration to each page of a PDF, creating a timed slideshow using Aspose.Pdf's PdfPageEditor.

set-split-page-transition.title: Set Split Transition on PDF Page
set-split-page-transition.description: Shows how to apply a Split page transition lasting two seconds to a specific page in a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.

disable-page-transition-animation.title: Disable Transition Animation on Page 6 of a PDF
disable-page-transition-animation.description: Shows how to set the transition duration to zero for a specific page using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfPageEditor, thereby disabling the page transition animation.

set-sequential-page-transitions.title: Apply Different Page Transitions Sequentially in a PDF
set-sequential-page-transitions.description: Shows how to assign a variety of transition effects to each page of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf facades, then save and optionally concatenate the document.

set-page-zoom-to-100-percent.title: Set Zoom to 100% for All PDF Pages
set-page-zoom-to-100-percent.description: Demonstrates how to set the zoom factor to 1.0 (100 %) for every page of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfPageEditor.

set-zoom-on-odd-pages.title: Apply Zoom to Odd PDF Pages
set-zoom-on-odd-pages.description: Demonstrates how to use Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfPageEditor to apply a 1.2× zoom factor to all odd‑numbered pages of a PDF and save the result.

set-zoom-on-even-pdf-pages.title: Set Zoom on Even PDF Pages
set-zoom-on-even-pdf-pages.description: Shows how to apply a uniform 0.8 zoom factor to all even‑numbered pages of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf's PdfPageEditor facade.

resize-specific-pdf-pages-to-us-letter.title: Resize PDF Pages to US Letter Size (Pages 3-6)
resize-specific-pdf-pages-to-us-letter.description: Shows how to set the page dimensions of specific PDF pages to US Letter size using Aspose.Pdf.

set-last-page-size-a5.title: Set Last PDF Page Size to A5 for Booklet
set-last-page-size-a5.description: Shows how to load a PDF, locate the last page, and resize it to A5 dimensions to create a compact booklet format.

rotate-every-third-pdf-page.title: Rotate Every Third PDF Page to Landscape
rotate-every-third-pdf-page.description: Shows how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, rotate each third page by 270° to achieve landscape orientation, and save the modified document.

retrieve-page-size-after-rotation.title: Get Page Size After Rotation
retrieve-page-size-after-rotation.description: Loads a PDF, rotates a specified page by 90 degrees, then reads and displays the page's width and height after the rotation, and optionally saves the rotated document.

retrieve-verify-page-rotation-after-resi.title: Retrieve and Preserve Page Rotation After Resizing PDF Page
retrieve-verify-page-rotation-after-resi.description: The example loads a PDF, reads the rotation of the first page, changes the page size, saves the document, and then verifies that the rotation value remains unchanged.

apply-custom-page-transitions.title: Apply Custom Page Transitions Based on Index
apply-custom-page-transitions.description: Shows how to assign different transition effects to each PDF page using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfPageEditor, alternating between dissolve and split transitions.

set-per-page-display-duration.title: Set Page Display Duration Incrementally in PDF
set-per-page-display-duration.description: Shows how to load a PDF and use PdfPageEditor to assign a DisplayDuration to each page, increasing the duration by one second for each subsequent page.

center-page-content-horizontally.title: Center Text on Second PDF Page
center-page-content-horizontally.description: Shows how to load a PDF, access the second page, and add a text fragment that is horizontally centered using the Alignment property.

vertically-center-page-content.title: Vertically Center Content on PDF Page 3 Using PdfContentEditor
vertically-center-page-content.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF with PdfContentEditor, attempting to align the content of page 3 to the middle vertically, and saving the document, while noting the need for a newer Aspose.Pdf version for the Alignment feature.

set-horizontal-alignment-and-zoom-on-pag.title: Zoom Page and Add Centered Text Stamp at Specific Point
set-horizontal-alignment-and-zoom-on-pag.description: Shows how to apply a 200% zoom to page 4 of a PDF and place a centered text stamp at coordinates (1,2) on the same page using Aspose.Pdf.

add-10-percent-margins-to-pdf-pages.title: Batch Resize PDF Pages by 10% Margin
add-10-percent-margins-to-pdf-pages.description: Demonstrates how to use Aspose.Pdf's PdfPageEditor to scale the content of every page in a PDF to 90 % (adding a 10 % margin) and save the resized document.

batch-set-fade-transition-pdf-slideshow.title: Set Fade Transition for All PDF Pages
batch-set-fade-transition-pdf-slideshow.description: Demonstrates how to apply a 2‑second Fade transition to every page of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf's PdfPageEditor.

resize-pdf-pages-using-pdfpageeditor.title: Resize PDF Pages from Byte Array
resize-pdf-pages-using-pdfpageeditor.description: Shows how to load a PDF from a byte array, adjust the width and height of each page, and save the modified document to a new file.

dispose-pdfpageeditor-properly.title: Edit PDF Pages and Rotate with PdfPageEditor
dispose-pdfpageeditor-properly.description: Demonstrates how to delete, add, and rotate PDF pages using Aspose.Pdf's Document and PdfPageEditor classes while correctly disposing resources with using statements.

set-custom-page-size-with-pdfpageeditor.title: Set Custom Page Size for PDF Pages
set-custom-page-size-with-pdfpageeditor.description: Shows how to change the width and height of each page in a PDF by modifying the PageInfo properties using Aspose.Pdf.

set-page-transitions-fade-boxout-cover.title: Set Page Transitions (Fade, BoxOut, Cover) in PDF
set-page-transitions-fade-boxout-cover.description: Demonstrates how to assign different page transition effects (Fade, BoxOut, Cover) to each page of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

set-pdf-page-zoom-using-double-precision.title: Export PDF Pages as PNG with Custom Zoom
set-pdf-page-zoom-using-double-precision.description: Demonstrates how to render each page of a PDF to PNG using a high‑precision zoom factor by adjusting the DPI via Aspose.Pdf's Resolution class.

set-slide-display-duration-pdf-presentat.title: Set Slide Transition Duration in PDF Presentation
set-slide-display-duration-pdf-presentat.description: Shows how to apply a uniform transition type and display duration (in seconds) to every page of a PDF, turning it into a timed presentation using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.

resize-pdf-contents-uniform-margin.title: Resize PDF Page Contents with Uniform Margins
resize-pdf-contents-uniform-margin.description: Shows how to apply equal margins to the contents of all pages in a PDF using Aspose.Pdf's ContentsResizeParameters and PdfFileEditor.

resize-pdf-contents-top-bottom-margins.title: Resize PDF Contents with Custom Top and Bottom Margins
resize-pdf-contents-top-bottom-margins.description: Demonstrates how to adjust the vertical spacing of all pages in a PDF by applying different top and bottom margins using Aspose.Pdf's ContentsResizeParameters and ResizeContents.

rotate-and-reset-pdf-page-orientation.title: Rotate PDF Page and Reset Orientation
rotate-and-reset-pdf-page-orientation.description: Shows how to rotate the first page of a PDF by 90 degrees using Aspose.Pdf, save the result, then load the rotated file, reset the rotation to its original state, and save again.

change-pdf-page-size-and-undo.title: Change PDF Page Size and Revert to Original
change-pdf-page-size-and-undo.description: Demonstrates how to capture a PDF page's original dimensions, apply a custom page size, and then revert to the saved original size to test undo functionality.

log-pdf-page-property-changes.title: Log PDF Page Modifications (Rotation, Size, Blank Detection)
log-pdf-page-property-changes.description: Shows how to rotate each page, resize pages to A4, detect blank pages, and log every property change to a text file using Aspose.Pdf and its Facades API.

report-pdf-page-properties-before-after.title: Generate PDF Page Properties Report with Size, Rotation, and Zoom Changes
report-pdf-page-properties-before-after.description: The example loads a PDF, records each page's size, rotation and zoom, modifies the page dimensions and rotation, applies a zoom factor using PdfPageEditor, and creates a text report showing the before‑and‑after values.

rotate-pages-encrypted-pdf.title: Process Encrypted PDF with Password Using PdfPageEditor and Document
rotate-pages-encrypted-pdf.description: Demonstrates loading an encrypted PDF with a password, applying page‑level alignment via PdfPageEditor, then performing further manipulations such as page deletion and adding a text annotation using the Document API.

resize-pdf-pages-preserve-annotations.title: Resize PDF Pages While Preserving Annotations
resize-pdf-pages-preserve-annotations.description: Shows how to load a PDF, change each page to A4 size, and save it while keeping all annotations and interactive elements intact using Aspose.Pdf.

rotate-pdf-pages-preserve-form-fields.title: Rotate PDF Pages While Preserving Form Fields
rotate-pdf-pages-preserve-form-fields.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF, rotating each page 90° clockwise, and saving the document while keeping interactive form fields intact.

apply-transition-to-odd-pages.title: Apply Transition to Odd Pages in PDF
apply-transition-to-odd-pages.description: Shows how to add a page transition effect only to odd‑numbered pages of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfPageEditor.

set-display-duration-even-pages.title: Set Display Duration for Even-Numbered PDF Pages
set-display-duration-even-pages.description: Shows how to assign a custom display duration to even-numbered pages in a PDF using Aspose.Pdf's PdfPageEditor.

zoom-pdf-pages-with-images.title: Zoom PDF Pages Containing Images
zoom-pdf-pages-with-images.description: Shows how to detect pages that have image resources in a PDF and apply a zoom factor only to those pages using Aspose.Pdf.

resize-contents-on-text-pages.title: Resize PDF Contents Only on Pages Containing Text
resize-contents-on-text-pages.description: The example detects which pages of a PDF contain any text and then enlarges the contents of only those pages using Aspose.Pdf's page editor.

combine-page-rotation-zoom-presentation.title: Rotate and Zoom PDF Pages for Presentation
combine-page-rotation-zoom-presentation.description: Shows how to rotate each PDF page 90° clockwise and apply a zoom factor by resizing the page dimensions using Aspose.Pdf.

set-custom-a4-landscape-page-size.title: Set PDF Pages to A4 Landscape Size
set-custom-a4-landscape-page-size.description: Shows how to change every page in a PDF to A4 landscape dimensions by setting PageInfo.Width and PageInfo.Height with Aspose.Pdf.

set-pdf-page-size-to-letter-portrait.title: Set PDF Page Size to Letter Portrait
set-pdf-page-size-to-letter-portrait.description: Shows how to resize every page of a PDF to the standard Letter portrait dimensions (8.5" x 11") using Aspose.Pdf.

rotate-landscape-pdf-pages.title: Rotate PDF Pages Based on Landscape Metadata
rotate-landscape-pdf-pages.description: Loads a PDF, reads a custom "Landscape" metadata flag, rotates all pages 90° clockwise when the flag is true, and saves the modified document.

set-page-transition-duration-based-on-ti.title: Set Page Transition Duration Based on Title Length
set-page-transition-duration-based-on-ti.description: Demonstrates how to apply a page transition to each PDF page and adjust the transition duration according to the length of a title (simulated with the page number). The example uses Aspose.Pdf to edit pages in a loop and save the result.

adjust-page-zoom-based-on-word-count.title: Adjust Page Zoom Based on Word Count
adjust-page-zoom-based-on-word-count.description: Demonstrates how to extract text from each PDF page, compute a zoom factor from the word count, and apply per‑page zoom using Aspose.Pdf.

batch-adjust-pdf-page-size.title: Batch Set Individual Page Sizes for PDFs
batch-adjust-pdf-page-size.description: Demonstrates how to process a folder of PDF files and assign a specific page size to each page of each document using Aspose.Pdf.

extract-rotate-selected-pdf-pages.title: Extract and Rotate Selected PDF Pages
extract-rotate-selected-pdf-pages.description: Shows how to extract specific pages from a PDF, rotate those pages, and save the result as a new PDF using Aspose.Pdf's Facades and Document APIs.

merge-pdfs-with-uniform-margins.title: Merge PDFs with Uniform Page Size and Margins
merge-pdfs-with-uniform-margins.description: Demonstrates how to standardize page dimensions and margins for multiple PDFs using Aspose.Pdf, then merge the aligned documents into a single file.

resize-and-split-pdf-into-chapters.title: Resize PDF Pages and Split into Chapters
resize-and-split-pdf-into-chapters.description: Shows how to resize all pages of a PDF to a uniform A4 size and then split the document into separate chapter PDFs using Aspose.Pdf.

create-pdf-slideshow-with-page-transitio.title: Create PDF Slideshow with Page Transitions
create-pdf-slideshow-with-page-transitio.description: Shows how to apply page transition effects and set display durations for each page to turn a PDF into a slideshow using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.

center-page-content-set-display-duration.title: Center Page Content and Set Display Duration on PDF Page
center-page-content-set-display-duration.description: Demonstrates how to center the content of a specific PDF page and set its display duration to four seconds using Aspose.Pdf's PdfPageEditor.

add-5-percent-margins-and-print-pdf.title: Resize PDF Pages by 5% to Add White Margin
add-5-percent-margins-and-print-pdf.description: Shows how to increase each PDF page size by 5 % using Aspose.Pdf, creating extra white space around the existing content before saving.

add-15-percent-margins-to-pdf-pages.title: Apply 15% Margin Resize for Booklet Layout
add-15-percent-margins-to-pdf-pages.description: Shows how to add a 15% margin on each side of selected PDF pages to create a booklet‑friendly layout using Aspose.Pdf.

rotate-pdf-pages-to-landscape-brochure.title: Rotate PDF Pages to Landscape for Brochure Printing
rotate-pdf-pages-to-landscape-brochure.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF, rotating portrait pages to landscape, and resizing each page to standard A4 landscape dimensions suitable for brochure printing.

change-pdf-page-size-to-a3.title: Resize PDF Pages to A3 Size
change-pdf-page-size-to-a3.description: Shows how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, set each page's width and height to A3 dimensions, and save the modified document.

set-pdf-page-zoom-preview-final.title: Generate PDF Preview and Final Output with Zoom Scaling
set-pdf-page-zoom-preview-final.description: Shows how to render the first page of a PDF as a half‑size PNG preview and then save the document with original size using Aspose.Pdf's PngDevice and PdfPageEditor zoom settings.

hybrid-content-resize-mixed-margins.title: Resize PDF Contents Using Custom Margins
hybrid-content-resize-mixed-margins.description: Demonstrates how to create a ContentsResizeParameters instance with specific margins and use PdfFileEditor to resize the contents of all pages in a PDF, then save the result.

apply-page-transitions-by-index.title: Apply Page Transitions Based on Index Modulo Three
apply-page-transitions-by-index.description: Shows how to assign different page transition effects to each PDF page using PdfPageEditor, selecting the transition type according to the page index modulo three.

apply-rotation-size-zoom-to-pdf-pages.title: Apply Rotation, Resize, and Zoom to PDF Pages
apply-rotation-size-zoom-to-pdf-pages.description: Shows how to rotate pages, change their dimensions, and zoom the page content of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf and the PdfPageEditor facade.

resize-pages-two-and-four.title: Resize PDF Page Contents with Custom Margins
resize-pages-two-and-four.description: Demonstrates how to resize the contents of specific PDF pages (pages 2 and 4) by applying custom left and right margins using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.

resize-pdf-content-uniform-15-percent-ma.title: Create Uniform Content Scaling Parameters with 15% Margins
resize-pdf-content-uniform-15-percent-ma.description: Demonstrates how to instantiate a ContentsResizeParameters object with 15% margins for uniform scaling of PDF page contents using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.

get-pdf-page-size-with-error-handling.title: Get PDF Page Size with Error Handling
get-pdf-page-size-with-error-handling.description: Demonstrates retrieving the size of a PDF page using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfPageEditor and safely handling requests for non‑existent pages with try‑catch blocks.

apply-page-adjustments-from-json.title: Apply Page Settings from JSON to PDF
apply-page-adjustments-from-json.description: Loads a JSON configuration that defines rotation, margins, and background color per page, then applies those settings to each page of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf and saves the result.

edit-pdf-in-memory-using-pdfpageeditor__.title: Edit PDF Pages In Memory Using PdfPageEditor
edit-pdf-in-memory-using-pdfpageeditor__.description: Shows how to create a PDF in memory, rotate a page with PdfPageEditor, and save the edited document to another memory stream.

rotate-pdf-pages-using-pdfpageeditor__v2.title: Rotate a PDF Page Using PdfPageEditor
rotate-pdf-pages-using-pdfpageeditor__v2.description: Shows how to rotate a specific page of a PDF by setting the Rotation property of PdfPageEditor and saving the modified document.

resize-pdf-contents-asymmetric-margins.title: Resize PDF Page Contents with Asymmetric Margins
resize-pdf-contents-asymmetric-margins.description: Demonstrates how to resize the contents of all pages in a PDF using different left and right margins via Aspose.Pdf's ContentsResizeParameters and PdfFileEditor.

modify-pages-preserve-signature.title: Rotate First Page of a Signed PDF
modify-pages-preserve-signature.description: Shows how to rotate a specific page in a digitally signed PDF using PdfPageEditor, preserving the existing signature.
